metadata.description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace template: an end-to-end ticket delivery orchestrator, portable developer tooling, cross-repo workflows, and domain-neutral integration scaffolding. Every plugin is configured per repo — none of them ship knowledge of any particular codebase.

plugins.name: quorum-orchestrator
plugins.description: Governed delivery pipeline with triage, product shaping, two audit gates and a state machine in status.yml. Runs supervised or autonomous, one unit or a batch. Stack-agnostic via profile.yml.

plugins.name: quorum-tooling
plugins.description: Portable developer tooling: code review, SQL migration review (idempotency, destructive ops, lock/rewrite risk), unit-test generators (.NET 4.7.2 / .NET 9 / Jasmine / Vitest), a memory bank with an Obsidian adapter, manual QA test cases, sprint numbering, and branch naming. Stack-agnostic via profile.yml.

plugins.name: quorum-workflows
plugins.description: Cross-repo development workflows: ticket-story intake, AC-routed QA test plans with executor tracking, an agent journal for autonomous test runs, and an Obsidian knowledge vault.

plugins.name: quorum-integration-kit
plugins.description: Domain-neutral scaffolding for third-party integration partners: a pipeline generator driven by integration-profile.yml, a ticket-driven change planner, and two pre-merge agents (structural reviewer + change analyzer).
